semantics.time: keyframes.time and contact window times are normalized 0..1; atSeconds/startSeconds/endSeconds are seconds
semantics.rotation: All 18 bones have absolute parent-local xyzw unit quaternions. Canonical bind rotations are identity, arms down.
semantics.root: Root local rotation remains identity; rootMotion=false. referenceRootTranslationMeters is a test trajectory and must not be applied to the character in the viewer or game.
semantics.sampling: 30 intervals/second, including one end keyframe. Frame interpolation uses shortest-arc slerp and linear translations. Smooth authored phase curves are already baked; do not ease each 1/30-second interval.
semantics.presentation: Contact and event metadata is visual only. No animation event changes gameplay state.
semantics.ground: Apply skinning-aware ground clearance after mixing and skinning. Support contact windows are not a substitute for a whole-mesh floor audit.

blendPolicy.interruption: Snapshot the currently displayed blended pose, including residual velocities.
blendPolicy.locomotionPhase: Match alternating support phase when changing run/sprint/dribble speed.
blendPolicy.footLock: Solve support IK after blending; carry outgoing world anchor to release, then smoothly reduce weight.
